scenarios.trace: Likelihood (SR-18-A-LIK-INDEX, SR-18-A-LIK-BANDS): residual 2+2+1+2 = 7 -> band 7-8 -> High; override (SR-18-A-LIK-OVERRIDE) needs L3=3: L3=1 -> not engaged. Inherent (L3=3): 2+2+3+2 = 9 -> band 9-11 -> Near-certain; override engaged (L3=3, L2=2) but 'at least High' does not lower Near-certain. Severity (SR-18-A-SEV-INDEX, weights 1): B = Restricted 3 + age 0 + special/criminal-offence data (Art. 10) 2 (SR-18-B-FACTOR-B-SPECIAL) + vulnerability 0 = 5; C = scale 1 (100-9,999 matches a year) + aggregation 1 = 2; D = 0; E = 0; G = third-party source outside typical expectations 1; index = 5+2+0+0+1 = 8 -> [6.5, 8.5) -> Significant (SR-18-A-SEV-BANDS). Floors: literal reading not engaged (Art. 10 data are not special-category data, PGF-10); alternative reading would require at least Significant -> same band. Matrix (SR-08-B-MATRIX): (Significant, High) = High; inherent (Significant, Near-certain) = High. Target (PGF-22 PRR-PSI-01): L3 1 -> 0 gives 2+2+0+2 = 6 -> Medium; (Significant, Medium) = Medium; Low unreachable while severity is Significant (Significant row floor = Medium).

Likelihood: residual 2+3+1+0 = 6 -> band 4-6 -> Medium; override not engaged (L3=1). Inherent 2+3+3+0 = 8 -> band 7-8 -> High; override engaged (L3=3, L2=3) -> at least High -> High. Severity: B = Confidential 2 + 0 + special 0 (customer identifiers carry no offence information) + 0 = 2; C = scale 3 (>= 1,000,000 identifiers) + aggregation 0 = 3; D = shared with a recipient 1; E = 0; G = 0; index = 2+3+1+0+0 = 6 -> [3.5, 6.5) -> Moderate; no floor. Matrix: (Moderate, Medium) = Low; inherent (Moderate, High) = Medium.

track_a.trace: Residual max(High, Low) = High; inherent max(High, Medium) = High. S1 determines the tier.

track_b.trace: Given as a level in PGF-22 PRR-PSI-01; subfactor scores are not stated in v1, so the index is not recomputed. Reported to ERM separately; does not change track (a).
